name: memdb-openai
description: Shared durable memory (memdb) for OpenAI agents, with signed and Bitcoin SV-anchored provenance on every write.

interface.shortDescription: Shared agent memory with provable provenance
interface.longDescription: Recall, search and save durable memories (decisions, preferences, lessons, commitments) in a memdb store shared with other agents. Every memory saved through this plugin gets a provenance record signed by the memdb server and anchored in a Bitcoin SV transaction. The source is set by the server from the connection (OpenAI's connector client certificate), not by the model. The proof covers the channel, the time and integrity. It does not cover which model wrote the text.
